Jacey: Fleet of foot, except she's very aware of every step. I wonder if, in a past life, she wasn't an energetic mountain goat?
Jacinda: Stable and well-oiled like a a big old wooden doorway of a grand old house that's been looked after, Jacinda hangs in the wings expecting mostly fun, love and happiness to be her company for the day and/or evening. And she's patient. And if no one looks like they're going fix things then she'll begrudgingly take up the mantle herself.
Jacinta:
Jacinta needs a bit more pizazz in her life. How does one accomplish this? Right, well firstly, we want to see some hard, gut-busting exercise because when you feel energised and throbbing with life, wonderful and unpredictable things are more likely to happen. So forget the notion of attending pottery class, or some such thing Jacinta. Fuck that. Why not a nude drawing class? Imagine that? You get fit and for kicks you go and pose nude in front of a bunch of strangers? In fact, don’t get fit, just do it! Maybe spend some money is a sex shop? Why not? Whats wrong with more unadulterated pleasure in your life?
The point is, and it applies to everyone actually, try something new and scary and suddenly light and fresh air will blast into your soul and it will be the beginning of something.
What do you think Jacinta?…
Jack: Jack is often so busy, on her way to somewhere else, that she rarely has enough time to tell you what she’s up to or where she’s headed. Like her sister below, however, she is outstanding value.
Jackie: Like all Becs, Jackie doesn’t fuck around and she’s probably more streetwise that anyone. She never seems to have time for overly romantic exploits but she’s a sexy and sensual woman, if not in body then definitely in spirit.
Jaclin: The name of an intercontinental ballistic missile that was fired in the enemies direction but has always had gyroscope problems, and now looks like it's headed this way. Good one!
Jaclyn: An army tank in a past life, Jaclyn tends to bulldoze her way through problems as a means to overcome them. Why talk when you can just run over something, is what she'll tell you. We're not sure, but we suspect she's the record holder for the number of times she’s tossed wine in the face of a disrespecting man. And rightly so, funny thing is, some of them weren't even being disrespectful. They were just being a little intimidated and clumsy in the face of a girl they liked, and they happened to get her on an off day. Know what I mean?
Jacque: The name of a sexy pin stripe business suit for a very capable, sensual woman.
Jacqui: It almost goes without saying that Jacqui is beautiful and wild, but for fuck sake don’t ever get on her bad side.
Jacquie:
As subtle as a clay jug crunched into the side of your head, Jacquie is nothing if not transparent. Her energy leaves many of us exasperated and that’s just the way we (and she) loves it. She never sits still long enough to have any idea what the word ‘boredom’ even means. 

The end.
Jade: Jade kind of floats around in a daze and, like Doreen, she’s disbelieving at how wonderful the universe seems to be.
Jaida: Is she a little bit naive? Perhaps, but Jaida is on an early life (in reincarnational terms) which means she makes lots of mistakes and listens intently to all given advice. She certainly gives everyone their due without judgement, and there is no denying her passion for a cause that she believes in.
Jaime: Like one of those North Korean rockets that you aren't sure is armed or not, Jaime arrives on the scene with huge aura of unpredictability. Will she explode right there on the launch pad? Will she sail harmlessly out over the sea and crash into the Pacific somewhere? Will she in fact make a bee-line for Tokyo and detontate a 20 kiloton nuclear device above a city of 20 million people and kill everyone? Maybe she's full of little love-letters and isn't armed at all, other than with buckets of love? We don't know. We have no idea. Does anyone?...
Jaimi: Did you hear about the job interview she just went to? She didn't like the comment one of the panel gave her and so she stood up, picked up her chair and threw it out the window. It landed on the bonnet of a police car where two cops were innocently eating their lunch. That was the last any of us have heard from her. If you see her can you tell her she got the job? They were so impressed with her passion that they want her on board immediately.
Jaimie: On one level she is completely innocent. On another, she has a tattoo on her arse and wheels through life with a Samurai sword that she’s spent years training with.
Jaki: Jaki would make a pretty good cage fighter. She's tough, she's very bright, she's outstanding under pressure and, pain? It doesn't register with her until the fight/mission/lovers' tiff/stunt plane crash is over. If she's living, good. If she's not, well she won't worry about it because she won't be here. Funny as a dunny rat. Jaki.
Jali: Jali, a quiet piece of advice from Management: Have a crack at that thing in life that scares the shit out of you. It’s where greatness lies and where you really learn what you’re capable of. Even if you fail, the rewards are amazing. Let us know how you go…
Jalina: Jalina is the kind of girl who, in her job interview, comes across as being fastidious and rigorous, and capable of solving any myriad of problem. And she's a nice girl, don't you worry about that. But, when it all comes down to it, she gets side-tracked very easily and, because she's an optimist, she always seems to have a million projects that aren't quite finished. Know what I mean? Great lady though, and there's no way you'd sack her.
Jamaica: Gullible and funny, Jamaica has a very difficult time looking serious. On one hand this is a blessing - she has plenty of friends and a busy, invigorating social life - but people at job interviews find it difficult to believe that she seriously wants the position. I hope her parents, as odd as they are, are able to leave her a nicely sized inheritance. Jamaica, how about art school? That might be your ticket.
James: Yes, there was a Boy Named Sue and there is, let me tell you, a Girl Named James, and she's bloody lovely. And cute. And she's got a tattoo on her arse like her long lost cousin (Jaimie) because she's a woman all right, and she'll tell you what's what. And because every day she flummoxes people with her name, she's got a lightning quick wit and she can deal with change/adversity as well as anyone. Not bad eh?
Jamie: Jamie is cut from the same chunk of marble as her sister (Jaimie) but she has a greater capacity to unravel in comparatively straightforward situations.
Jamie-Lee: Jamie-Lee is a fire ball. Pure and simple.
Jamieson: Surprisingly persistent and partially tomboy-ish, Jamieson cant be dissuaded of something if she believes in it, and rightly so. She likes nice wine and educated men, although there was a patch there in her teens where she was the textbook rebel/nightmare. Her parents quite feared for her at one stage, but she blew out of that like a pro-surfer being blown out of the barrel of his or her life. Adored by those who know her well.
Jan: Travel agent. She can organise nine different itineraries at once while simultaneously holding two other conversations with a bunch of annoying American tourists, who aren’t even purchasing any tickets to anywhere. (She knows that before they do.) But, she rarely loses her cool and on the weekend she coaches netball.
Jana: You’ll need a workman’s helmet if you intend to try and get close to her because Jana is a smooth concrete wall. (She once fell over on a building site and killed a guy, that’s all.)
Janaya: As a product of the modern generation Janaya is only usually concerned with how attractive and likeable she is, and she has no idea what real work is about. But don’t worry. She’ll get there.
Jane: Welcome to one of the Enigmas. You might think that Jane rhymes with ‘Yes, done and finished,’ but you’d be wrong and the Plain Jane rumours are basically a load of shit. The entire word curls over in your head, and in your mouth as you say it, but the secret to Jane is to understand that it doesn’t just curl over and finish, because it’s a circle which keeps on going. What the hell are we talking about, you ask? In simple terms, and there’s not much which is simple about this girl, what you see is not who she is. Metaphorically, Jane is like that dedicated, insightful Lieutenant who is more well-informed, savvier and way wiser than the General above her who is making all the decisions, and Jane is not the only person in the Kingdom to suffer this fate. It’s why she looks a little frustrated, sometimes, and you can’t blame her. You want our advice Jane?….get out of the army and go start somewhere afresh where you’re either appreciated or in charge, and find yourself a lover who will randomly pull your trousers down and kiss your buttocks more than they do! Amen.
Janelle: Janelle is name given to the phenomenon of dropping a full  carton of milk onto the floor that ruptures badly, whereupon it covers the entire area in a sticky mess that takes three separate mopping events to clean up. And what does this mean? Janelle works hard, more than most, and for whatever reason she doesn't seem to ever have anywhere near enough time to simply have fun and to be silly. Can someone help this lass out please? She's helped enough and she deserves a mountain of fun.
Janet:
The tenacious ex-girl guide who, despite her best intentions, attracts peculiar events which many might deduce as being unlucky. I mean, yes, if a bus suddenly appears from nowhere and crashes through a puddle of water on the road in front of you, you’re probably liable to get angry. But honestly, why? It’s just water. Janet knows this, just as she understands that all events in life immediately become memories after they happen. The weirder things that happen to you (presuming no one is hurt or offended) the better. Her sense of humour is therefore a gift many people could learn from. 
Thank you Janet.
Janette:
"You can kiss me but just don’t spell my name wrong!"
For a long time Janette considered getting this tattooed across her arse cheeks. She didn’t in the end. But the moral to the story is true: she’s a staunch competitor and what she lacks in talent she makes up for with a splendid work ethic and a disciplined training regime. We love her up in the commentary box because something always happens when she’s out on the field.
Janice: Yes it's true that we were once concerned if she was alive or not but Janice has made a grand recovery. The crew up here in the box have been talking about her inclusion in the team all morning and they’re excited. Rarely do we see a player covered in more mud, so much so that sometimes we can barely see the number on her back, which makes her difficult to call sometimes, but you can't miss the hair. She fights hard for her team, never slacking off an inch, and her cries of exertion can be heard all around the stadium. We think she’ll do quite well today. And look at that! For the first time she's leading the team onto the arena. How wonderful! It’s about time her skills were recognised.
Janie: After backing your car into a telephone pole, she opens the door and hops out, shrugs her shoulders at you and smiles. “Oh well, sorry about that, but it’s just a car.”  And she’s right – it is just a car. The strange truth of the matter is that, of all the people you’d like to crash your car, Janie is the one. She is a happy soul with a rare smile and she’s therefore hard to say no to. In the annuls of the universe, therefore, you might as well give her your keys and ask her to crash it again. It’ll probably be funny.
Janina: Rarely downtrodden for very long, Janina will somehow always find a way to get the upper hand. I suppose you could say she's tenacious, and she is, but she's no idiot. As well, her dress sense can be a fascinating kaleidoscope on occasion, but it just adds to the energetic theme. In her younger day she hunted many-a-young-fellow with poise and style, always gauging the right time when to corner her prey. In a nutshell, she acts first and asks questions later. Amen.
Janine:
Okay, so once upon a time we described Janine as being a flat tyre but I think it’s time to fess-up. The fact of the matter is that Janines stopped being produced about 40 years ago because our manufacturing industry got sent offshore, and this is a tragedy. You see, the problem with the world today is that everyone wants a quick fix. Very few people can commit to long periods of hard work and even less are prepared to sacrifice their own happiness for the sake of helping others. Janine has this capacity and soon enough she will be extinct, along with all the Carols, the Roberts, the Brians and the Lynns. And that’s just the tip of the iceberg. And then we’ll be fucked, won’t we? So, no, Janine isn’t flashy but she’s real and she’s listening, so stuff that in your Facebook feed and smoke it. 
Thank you Janine. x
Janis: The Christmas Cake. Patient, lovely once you open her and always worth it, Janis doesn't get out anywhere near as much as she (and we) would like. Why is that? To be quite honest, up here in the commentary box we think it fitting to celebrate Christmas on the first of every month. Imagine how happy everyone would be? And imagine how often we'd get to see Janis in full flight, not stuck away in the bloody cupboard!
Janita:
Another country lass married to a country man. She lives in a country house with their country dogs and their country chickens, maybe even a few country sheep. Janita can mend a fence, milk a cow, drive a tractor and shoot crows.
“Dya need a hand, Cyril?” she asks her husband.
“.....aaah, yep,” he says, again. Etc etc
Janna: Yeah, well, we all love a bit of serenity in our lives don't we? Just a little time out to re-evaluate what we're up to; Perhaps get away from the screaming hordes with a good book?; Maybe a nice afternoon walk in the forest? Well Janna says she'd like to do some of these things, and she occasionally even makes plans to get away from her nutty friends and family for a bit, but she never seems to actually do it. There's always some unforseen disaster that needs her attention. Sure, she says the constant noise and cafuffle are a pain, but do we believe her? She's be screwed without her phone, for one thing, so maybe that's the key, just for 48hrs?
Jannetta:
Jannetta hasn’t got time to answer your questions about how to exactly spell her name because she moves too quickly to take the time to stop and tell you. 
Reactive? A little bit. 
Funny? Usually. 
Sexy? When she remembers what that’s all about, you bet. 
And busy. That’s our Jannetta. Even her kids shake their head at how busy she is.
Jannika: Very bright this one.  An excellent problem/puzzle solver. In middle age she's one of the few women who will give herself a project to do just to stave off boredom. The result of which might mean that she'll be renovating her house for years on end, never actually arriving at the finish line. Complexity: she loves it.
Jarneigh: Not entirely blessed with a long-term, measured understanding of the consequences of her actions, Jarneigh tends to jump in first and ask questions later. The world's too organised anyway, let's face it. Pretty soon they'll be taxing our need to breath oxygen, and when finally the uprising comes with spears and knives from those connected to the earth, you'll probably see Jarneigh in the leadership group, with feathers in her hair, giant silver bracelets around each bicep and riding a horse while wearing an outfit like a worrier princes. And she'll never die wondering....
Jasmine: Despite her initial shyness, she’s flourished into a sweet smelling, fast thinking, affable Goddess who turns a room when she’s wearing a blue dress.
Jasmyn: Jasmyn, we up here in the commentary box suggest you head on over to Jasmyne. I know, you haven't got your own theory but we think you're brilliant. Amen.
Jasmyne: Airy, bright, breezy, bouyant and cheerful: this are the usual qualities of Jasmyne. You wouldn't pick her as being that determined, only because the things she truly sets her heart on are rare. When she does though, you just watch - from under all that cruisy, smiley good humour will arise the steely queen.
Jasna: Jasna isn't big on solitude because it means she's alone with her own thoughts, and deep down she's not really sure what she wants from life…yet! J, if in doubt, do some good, hard exercise. It'll free your mind and provide clarity. True story.
Java: Was she conceived on the surf trip? Anyway, Java isn’t fussed what people make of her name because she’s here to make a life for herself, and maybe even a reputation. Perhaps all she needs is a healthy dose of compassion for the reactions of people (and peoples) whom she doesn’t know.
Jax: Miss W.B Sarcastic Bastard, who went to Thailand years ago and got a tattoo on the back of her neck that she was told said ‘Lotus’. Turns out that it translates as ‘Crack Whore’, which she’s obviously not.
Jayde: If Jade is a brand new ladies silver Rolex watch, then Jayde is the Indonesian imitation, and from up close you’d be hard-pressed to tell the difference.
Jaye: I read somewhere recently that SILENT is an anogram of LISTEN, and that about sums up the lovely and very intelligent Jaye.
Jayleena: Diminutive and shy, I don’t think so. Born of hardworking parents, Jayleena plans to do none of that. We’re not sure how she’ll cope, to be honest, but I guess her friends will have access to criminal monies so perhaps the sky is the limit. A note from Management Jayleena: beware the idiot driving a loud car which he hopes will impress you. Just make sure he has a brain as well.
Jayleigh: Shy and extremely timid - bullshit! Jayleigh likes it rough, she likes to play hard and she expects a few bumps because she enjoys delivering them.
Jaylene: Great friends with Raelene. Indeed, she's around at her house right now sitting alone in the kitchen. In front of her is her third whisky of the afternnoon. (Raelene is currently at the back door screaming at the kids who are creating mayhem out the back.)
Jayma: Jayma rhymes with “Can’t someone else do it?” It therefore takes a great effort for her to achieve anything and she’s a bit sick of feeling like she has to.
Jaymee: Friday after work, she goes out and grabs a box of beer, her fags, perhaps a little hooch, and she gets home with a smile on her face because now she's all set for the weekend.
Jayne: Come on Jayne! Snap out of it! Get up! Come on! Here’s your jacket, now just ignore what those rude pricks said to you and get out there and lay down the law!
Jazz: Jasmine isn’t really a follower of rules, anyway, but Jazz (and especially Jazzy, if she’s around) goes out of her way to break them, or at least to see what is possible in the universe. So long as she never decides to get breast implants she’ll be wonderful, even though everyone would still love her if she did.
Jeanette: The Bush Fire. And I mean, the healthy bushfire. Yes, the creatures will be scared shitless and will flee for their lives, but she is refreshing and life-giving and don’t forget it. The forest needs her and WE need her, it's that simple.
Jeannie: Woah, that girl can drink. It might be the thing that gets her in the end, but you can't tell me she isn't a happy soul.
Jedda: Jedda struggles with being kept indoors.
Jelena: A staunch competitor. Yes, she has a sense of humour, but probably not when she's losing, although she is evolving as a human very well. Jelena is another whose aura attracts her fair share of attention, which is fine, but the boys in the commentary box want more people to make her laugh. Let us know how it goes...
Jem: Jem is fast on her feet, quick in her thoughts, wise in her actions, passionate and experimental in the kitchen and the bedroom, and all-in-all she is going places. In fact, let's face it, she’s already there. Jem
Jemaya: Jemaya is cute, normal and reliable, but she’s about as earth-shattering as a box of Weeties, or maybe Coco Pops. (Justin loves her.)
Jemene:
"Hang on, what? Can you say that again, please?"
"Sure. She's gone to visit her mate in Europe. She told me to tell you. She thinks you're an arsehole."
"Jemene, she's left me? And gone to Barcelona?"
"Yes, you idiot! What'd you think was going to happen? She wasn't going to put up with your behaviour for more than five minutes so she left. I don't blame her."
Jemima: As a gorgeous ex-North American Indian squaw, Jemima is possibly the most beautiful and charismatic Tom Boy in existence.
Jemma: Jemma is deceptively sensitive and thoughtful. And she can work alone. For example, on a family holiday to Tahiti recently, Jem' disappeared for an hour and a half and there was only one place she was going to be: we found her spear-fishing on her own about 300 metres from shore, out there on the reef front.
Jen:
Does a more powerful, sensual and remarkable combination of letters exist in the English language?
The answer: Perhaps not.
Jeneane:
Jeneane is one of these people that slips under the radar. You wouldn't normally think she is a sexual demon, yet she is. You may not credit her general knowledge to be enough to take the controls of this light plane, whose pilot just died of a heart attack, but it is. Equally, you might not perceive her to be sensitive enough to deal with your very private and sad situation, but she is. Indeed, right now she's the ONLY ONE you need to be talking to.

Moral to the story? Never judge Jeneane's book its cover.
Jenece: Jenece has toiled hard during the game because there weren't enough players on the bench to give her a rest, so she’s looking forward to the siren going so she can take her boots off and have a drink. In summation, Jenece would have loved to have been able to be lazy over the course of her life, but who had time for that?
Jeneen: Yep, okay, so she's had her fair share of impediments in her life, but she always manages a way through, and she rarely gives up. As a younger lass Jeneen's first decisions may not have always been the best (eg. cars, husbands, houses etc) but she's either wisened up or she's stopped letting fools make decisions for her. Her gut reactions are always on the money and it's only now in her life that she's really beginning to relax into her skin properly.
Jeneil:
Alright, so she isn't gracing the covers of the glamour magazines or keeping us titilated with scandalous gossip. Good! Unlike Jeneil, it seems the whole world is trying to be famous these days; desperate to be heard; aching to be lauded. What a load of bolony!
Jeneil, thank you for keeping it real and for caring for us, no matter how much we carry on.
Amen.
Jeni: Jeni is actually pretty relaxed most of the time until she gets extremely stressed, at which point the only thing that will calm her down is a packet of 300 new un-sharpened pencils and a sharpener. Yep, I know what your'e thinking and, no, we have no idea why she gets off on that either.
Jenice: Now listen here! Stop complaining about how your name is spelt and lift your eyes up to the horizon. Take your imagination there, as you walk. Do it. Excellent, now, kick all those fucking children out of the house when they turn 18, no matter what, and do something that you’ve always wanted to do, regardless of the consequences. (That’s right. Jenice spends too much energy on people who are too bloody lazy.)
Jenn: Sexier than she thinks or knows, Jenn enjoys people and gets on well with everyone, and she is a good friend to have – on all levels – at least 89% of the time.
Jenn-Jenn: Is she a fire engine? Well, not quite but she could be. Jenn-Jenn is never shy and likes to keep things moving. Very bright and with a million friends, the only odd thing about Jenn-Jenn is that she'll tell you she has a mystical cross on both hands that, according to legend, makes her a healer. She certainly gives good advice so who knows, maybe she is a hidden healer?
Jenna: Jenna is a sexy girl, but one more ‘n’ in her name and you would risk falling asleep shortly after you met her. As it is, it only tends to make her a little lazy. Jenna, is that fair or not?  You can’t blame her I suppose. You hear her name and for a moment you wonder if you misheard it; “Was that Jenna, Jemma or Janna I just met?” In summation, Jenna is a party girl and we just hope she comes out the other end of this era in her life intact!
Jennaya:
Mixed-up? Perhaps. Although only for a little while and it’s not her fault anyway. Having unreliable and crazy parents makes it difficult for anyone to lay down a solid, moral foundation, but this is Jennaya’s niche. However, if she can extricate her mind from the trivial crap in her midst, this chaos will produce a powerful, funny lady who has no qualms about taking the reins and calling a spade a spade. The fruits will arrive in adulthood a little later on, that’s all.  
As a youngster, all we urge is that she takes a second to ponder the consequences of her actions, and those of her friends’. And keep her out of the kitchen, for god’s sake.
Jenne: Another stalwart of the community. Sure, she gets a bit weird about the misspelling of her name, but it’s probably a first world problem. However, when was the last time her husband tossed her onto the bed and ravished her in a moment of delightful surprise? Good bloody question…
Jenness: One of the few women on Earth who always seems to carry a pen on her.
Jenneth: Jenneth is woken by her alarm at around 3am, because life on the land begins early. Perhaps she's off to milk the cows, maybe she needs to get some feed over to the stables, or perhaps she needs to meet the young fellas who are coming around to begin their day behind the wheel of a combine harvester? Either way, Jenneth is a hard-working, easy-smiling lady who cant imagine how city folk live. And she can't stomach a man who can't deal with engines and a welder.
Jenni: High pitched nasal voice. She worries a lot.
Jennie: Polite. She busies her herself with kids, the shopping, the house and she seems to look like she's thinking hard about the next chore, most of the time.
Jennifer: If she insists on being called Jennifer then you must say hello and, even if you don’t know any martial arts, at least pretend to make some kind of karate defence stance. If she doesn’t attack, make a hasty retreat. That’s it.
Jennifer-Penny: The opposite of a spendthrift, Jennifer-Penny may have European bankers as recent ancestors. If that's the case, then the edges of her material life are sealed off to prevent any leaks. It's not to say she doesn't enjoy herself within whichever aspect of the arts or of life that she loves, but outside that she'll happily wear the same pair of cruddy runners for years, and almost never see fit to replace her bed.
Jenny: The Community and family stalwart who is hard-working and very polite.
Jerneen: Maybe she smoked a heap of pot when she was younger, but Jerneen moves with all the speed and grace of a plastic bag wafting down the street.  Treachery and dishonesty are none of her business.
Jerrami: Jerrami rarely has a bad word for anyone. Physically active and happy, she always seems to be on the move and you will never see her in the company of morose or unsocialable people.
Jerri: Jerri comes out with all guns blazing. Doesn’t matter where she is or what she’s up to. But, it’s kind of nice to know that, deep down, she’s something of a hopeless romantic. Can someone just give her a good hug once in a while? Cheers.
Jerry: Jerry fights the masculine shit in her name, head-on, by being dashing, daring and exotic.
Jes:
Remember that scene at the beginning of ‘The Empire Strikes Back’, when Han Solo discovers Luke out there in the snow? Luke is unconscious, injured, freezing and close to death. Han Solo makes a snap decision. The weird kangaroo-horse type animal he was riding dies of exertion and the cold, and there is nothing for it: Han gets Luke's lightsaber, cuts open the guts of the creature and despite the horrid stench, he pushes the unconscious Skywalker inside the warm body of the dead animal. The act saved Luke's life, which in turn, let's face it, saved the universe. 
Well, Han Solo was taught that move by Jes out in the bush. She’s good at this sort of stuff.
Jeska: Asthmatic - who isn't these days?- but a delightful girl who walks around with a smile.
Jess: Jess may or may not be the most stunning girl in the room, but she certainly does nothing by halves.
Jessami: Is she rational, many people ask? The answer is that, yes, she is, generally. What you have to remember with Jessami is that this is her first time on Earth. So, everything is new and wonderful, and almost to funny and bizarre for her to comprehend, do you know what I mean? For entertainment of an evening, don't turn on the tele' - go and hang out with Jessami. All kinds of crazy shit will happen, and not much of it wont be funny. Good luck!
Jessekah: Let me put it this way, if you are a scientist or philosopher from the opposing side, and the enemy grants you safe passage through their territories, offering you Jessekah as an escort, you can be assured that you will not be harmed. She will adhere to her orders to the letter and tend to your safety and needs as surely as if you were her kin. However, if you are a spy she will detect it and have you assassinated without so much as a second thought. (Note: do try to spell her name correctly.)
Jessemine: Well, yes, she made it through officer's training but to be honest she never quite got a handle on the nuances of being in charge of a large ship. Yep, she doesn't mind speed boats and the like, and she's good at ordering underlings around, but put her in charge of a destroyer and the first thing that would happen is that she'd probably destroy the dock by crashing into it, and this despite the warnings. We think it's because she gets distracted easily, which is a bloody dangerous situation when you're behind the helm of a 20,000 ton vessel. Out in the real, civilian world is where Jessemine belongs, where, once she knows what she's doing, she's ace. (As a wee side note, her boyfriends are fearful of arguing with her.)
Jessica: Frumpy. She wails at her own birthday party when she realizes that there aren’t enough presents, of which there rarely is.
Jessica-Anne:
The wanna-be kitchen/interior designer. 
The End.
Jessie: Jessie lives on a farm that’s had no rain for six years and she’s skilled at putting down horses with the back of an axe.
Jessy: Jessy, like her twin, lives on a farm that’s had no rain for six years and, yes, she’s skilled at putting down horses with the back of an axe. In fact, axe, log, truck, stick, fist - she has loads of initiative.
Jesuloluwa: Her family hails from somewhere on the African continent and apart from being born with natural rhythm, all we know is that she has an amazing smile that will lead her on quite an unexpected path.
Jewel:
Please tell me she’s no pushover who is aiming for nothing more than her own, personal mortgage. Let me hear great tales of the returned underdog. Regale us with stories of her traipsing across the Mongolian steppes, or forging a remote Canadian river in only bare feet because wolves ate her uggies, or perhaps fending off vultures in Africa having lain injured for 24 hrs…..go on…..tell me something like that. Don’t show me a picture of a girl in a bright coloured shirt wearing a name badge, trying to sell me a fucking telephone plan, and whose been brainwashed to within an inch of her life. 

Jewel?…
Jill: Jill is kind of fun but she’s a bit too organised.
Jillane:
A weird name and a funny and unorthodox lady. We strongly suspect the rule book was tossed out with the water of the bathtub  she was born in after she arrived on Earth, that day. She's one of these people who, to amuse themselves from time to time, will walk right up to you, right inside your personal space, get their nose one inch from yours, look you in the eye and ask, "How the fuck are  ya?"
Her job, here on Earth, is to provide those around her with a different perspective. No, she's never going to be brainwashed by Western Society's behaviour walls, and thank god for that, eh?
Jilli:
Jilli accidentally gave her grandfather a heart attack when she was young. Bored one day, she stole a fire-cracker from the shop, back in the days when you could do such things, and stuck it under his morning chair. (Each day, of course, he'd sit out there in the sunshine and read the paper.) 
Anyway, nowadays he's happy as a peach up there in Morning Paper Heaven and he doesn't begrudge Jilli one bit.
Back here on Earth, in adulthood not much has altered, really. If Jilli is bored and near you, you need to prepare yourself for anything.
Jillian: The manager of the typing pool. She rules her girls with an iron fist, and there is a rumour going around that she had something to do with the disappearance of her ex-husband. Note: There’s at least some red in her hair and the boys in the commentary box secretly adore her.
Jina:
Perpetually in your face, Jina is a great ally and a Tour de Force in her own right. 
"Come on, you can do better," she says, either by words or by the examples of her actions. 
If she's scheming you'll know about it, indeed, you'll be joining-in whether you like it or not.
I can't imagine her sleeping very much.
Jo: Highly intelligent and extremely thoughtful, Jo is a sensitive, sensual woman. Once in a while she is reasonably psychotic but, generally, she’s adaptable and compassionate.
Joan: Well, yes, she's beautiful and potent, and smarter than Fergus. What you may not know is that not only did she win the country's national beauty pageant, but she's spent most of the last 20 years exploring the islands strewn across the Western Pacific in a sailing boat. And you should see her in the kitchen - even with her clothes on!
Joanie:
Metaphorically, Joanie regularly rappels down the faces of mountain cliffs, builds houses in order to promote her empire and divvies out goodies like they’re going out of fashion. 
(Note: If she is Kiwi, however, it’s pertinent to remember she is dangerous when out of it.)
Joanna: Joanna was screamed at by her parents as a child quite a bit, so these days you can’t blame her for being off in her own little world most of the time. But it’s only made her great, because it turned her into an upright, intelligent personality. Odd at times too, but I suppose that applies to all of us at some time or another. And she has sex appeal, ladies and gentemen.
Joanne: Joanne rhymes with Routine. As an accountant who lives in Mt.Isa, she made herself famous at the office last summer during that hot spell. It was 44 degrees at 2pm for two weeks straight and she wore her grey woollen skirt every single day.
Joasia: Joasia is a girl who is a rushin' and in order to save time, which she is constantly short of, she therefore endeavours to combine as many chores as possible. For example, if she saw a guy she liked out in the surf, waiting for a wave, she would swim out to him from shore, free style, and go say hello. From his point of view it is a rather romantic and unusual gesture, and not one easily forgotten. Joasia, of course, is just dying for a pee and couldn't be bothered walking to the toilets.
Jocelyn: Jocelyn was reared by foster parents after her biological parents were killed in a plane crash when she was three. However, her foster mother, jealous of Jocelyn’s intelligence and niceness, made her life a misery. She is a librarian now and, Jocelyn, it’s never too late to be anything you want, so what are you waiting for?
Jocy: Jocy rhymes with Cosy, almost, and she kind of fits and hits you when you least expect it.
Jode: Feared by many and loved by many, Jode has a mean temper like her occasionally twisted sisters, below, but she’s far more relaxed. She drives fast on the road and expects others to do the same, and she’s extremely sexy, but not many people know that she can actually see the aura of individuals when she puts her mind to it. Jode is an incredible woman.
Jodi: Jodi, darlin', we suggest you suck it up and go on over to Jodie. It's all good.
Jodie: Similar to a gorgeous looking feral cat, if you corner her or piss her off there is a fair chance you won’t live to tell the tale. But, feed her well, stay out of her way if she’s in a bad mood and mind what you say in her presence, and you’ll be fine.
Jodie-Anne: You should see the amount of food she throws out every week. We heard recently that the world wastes 50% of all food produced and Jodie-Anne contributes more than her fair share. Moral to the story: Jodie-Anne, stay focussed and plan to fully finish!
Jody: See Jodie, except that she is slightly calmer.
Joedi: It's a hell of a clan, isn't it - the Jodie/Jodi/Jody clan, that is. Joedi is another one. Here again, if you meet her we'd advise being very careful not to spell her name wrong, but honestly why they put an 'e' in there is anyone's guess. Be that as it may Joedi is tenacious, she's funny, she'll tell you when she's pissed-off/horny/hungry or happy, but usually she won't need to say anything. She doesn't plan too far ahead and she never forgets a fuckwit. So, you got all that? Good luck!
Joelene: Brash. Relaxed. Super-smart. Joelene is all of these things and more. Finding beauty in the small things and chilling out about the large dramas are some of her skills. Okay, we admit, there have been a few anger issues in the past but she's over all that now. And there she goes, off into the sunset on her horse leaving a trail of dust. Who knows where she's headed? Did she tell anyone where she's going? ...No? Oh well, hopefully we'll see her again.
Joellen: I'm not quite sure how she does it. If Joellen does something  as banal as drive down the street for juice and perhaps some eggs, even if she's on her own she'll kind of blast and rumble her way in the front door of the grocery store such that everyone's attention inside will be gripped by her arrival. For half a second they will think that she has an entourage of three or four people. This happens everywhere she goes.
Joey: The cheeky life of a cheeky party and/or swingers’ gathering.
Johanna: As a lioness in a past life, Johanna enjoys nothing more than lounging around the house in the nude and sleeping as much as possible. Having done all her killing eons ago, these days she’s a sensitive soul with a soft name, and she is much better suited to lazy life on the French Riviera.
Johllene: “Oh dear oh dear,” the match referee says to himself as Johllene struts onto the court. Yes, she's a wonderful player to watch and very melodramatic. While it's nigh on impossible to cheat these days, given the number of cameras focussed on the contest, he knows full-well that Johllene will undoubtedly bamboozle both her opponent and him (possibly even the crowd) with some half-baked decoy show that will confuse everybody. Is that cheating? Well, some might say yes it is, but this is entertainment after all. And that's why we're here, so, he takes a breath and the game begins...
Johnno: Men want her. Women want to be like her. She works for either an ad agency or a publishing house and she’s good at what she does. Not really belonging in the fast lane, Johnno seems well-suited to a life by the beach whether she swims much or not.
Joi: Joi gives birth to many ideas and most of them are taken up with abject enthusiasm because, one, they are well thought out, two, they aim to make life better and more fun, and, three, they are nearly always fair and equitable. Sounds heavy. It isn't. Joi is here for a good time, exploring the world and herself as much as she can, while at the same time doing good. Joi is a gem.
JoJo: Not really flowing like a river through a serene and quiet valley, more like a raft full of sexy and horny backpackers blasting their way over rapids on the Zambezi River with the expectation of a near-death experience today, followed by copious amounts of alcohol/recreational drugs or fornication tonight. This is our JoJo. She’s a bloody gem, not to mention highly intelligent although you’d never know it, only because she doesn’t flaunt it.
Jolanda: If Jolanda says she's going to do something, then she will do it, never flinching at what the consequences are. As a smart and loyal individual, she also only throws her affections at people that she feels are solid in both temperament and trust. Very passionate, Jolanda milks moments for their best parts and we could do worse that have her represent us at the UN. And she has wonderful long legs.
Jolene: Jolene was born to move. If she were a gymnist who tosses of those ribbons into the air while performing amazing feats, for example, she could perform her routine and not miss a beat while at the same time hold a completely normal conversation with you as  you stand on the sideline. The fact that she is also quite beautiful doesn't effect her life one way or the other.
Jolie: Great traveller and a cool chicken, all round. Jolie is the kind of girl, who, if walking a mountain trail with three guys she met at the backpackers, and who she trusted on sight in lieu of her radar being splendid, would react first when the group stumbles upon a 20 metre waterfall. "Right, well I'll see you guys in the water," she says, without hesitation. Then, BANG!, over she goes.....!
Joni: Hooly dooly! Where do you start and where do you finish? No, Joni doesn't sit around waiting for life to come to her, don't you worry about that. In her younger years she even gave Lucy a run for her money in terms of some of the fun she got into around the place. Heavens to Betsy! Luckily, she hasn't really slackened off. She's here to help, she laughs deeply and infectiously and, by God, if she's in a foul mood then run for the hills kids.
Jonika: Jonika seems to relish confrontations and she’s definitely good to have around when difficult projects need to be finished-up.
Jooles: Jooles is the kind of girl who attracts ridiculous and hilarious moments of coincidence. For example, the last time she had hiccups she accidentally swallowed a fly, which sent her into cataclysmic fits of vomitting, which is tough to do when you're still trying to hiccup. This is Jooles for you. But she can laugh about her misadventures as much as anyone.
Jordan: Baby, yes, your looks may get you quite some way but there's more to it than that. You don't need your friends around you always, so, stand up straight, take responsibility for your actions, as well as a big breath, and step towards where you want to go. Only you can do it and it'll be worth it!
Jordana: Like Flick before her, Jordana is deeply attracted to anything shiny -  eg. big black men with bright teeth, neon lights, jewellery shops and just about anything that sparkles. Her grand plan in life, therefore, is to live in Las Vegas and work as a knife-wielding flame-thrower.
Jorja: Why does she always need that final little leg up, right at the end of a project? It's a mind trick she's playing with herself, you understand. Deep down, Jorja is just as confident and capable as anyone. She just forgets sometimes, that's all. In fact, if you know her, the next time she starts complaining that the piece won't fit, or she's too tired to make it to the top, or the wetsuit is too tight (even though she's worn it many times before), don't pander to her. Give her some friendly abuse. In fact, if she's half in that wetsuit when she starts whinging, push her over because sometimes a cushy response does no one any good at all.
Jorji: Her parents collect grass as a hobby so, Jorji, do like a few others in the Kingdom have done and leave home ASAP! (Jorji, herself, is a spiffing young lass who has time for everyone.)
Jorjia: Impulsive. We think it's because she wants to get people to REMEMBER HOW TO SPELL HER NAME!
Joscelin: Josceline was also reared by foster parents after her biological parents were killed in a plane crash when she was three. And yes, her foster mother, jealous of her intelligence and niceness, made her life a misery. She is a librarian now and, J, it’s never too late to be anything you want, so what are you waiting for?
Jose:
She's been told a million times of course, but in the end her commanders gave up. Especially as she does her job better than anyone. She's in the artillery. Her job, once the cannon shell is placed into the barrel, is to run around the front and get her big stick thing, shove it down the end of the barrel and push the shell back into the chamber as far as it will go, jump out of the way and scream, "FIRE!". 
What her superiors find distracting is that she refuses to go into battle wearing anything other than a bikini. Yes, we know, she's receives the odd cordite burn but that doesn't bother her. "If we're going to be blowing people up," she says, "we might as well look as sexy as we can."
You can’t argue against logic like that. (And you should see her on the dance floor.)
Josephina: Josephina is a border-line saint. Had Sleeping Beauty been drawn with blonde hair instead of black, this would have been her name.
Josephine: A beautiful romantic who is often let down by the men in her life. In short, she’s the perfect wine glass waiting for the perfect wine.
Josie: Josie is very lucky, although you do create your own, so they say, because she is lovingly in touch with her kismet. And what choice do any of us have? (Josie, have you thought about giving lectures on the topic?)
Joss: Joss owns a pair of hiking boots that have trekked across the Andes, through Nepal, and currently are taking her up Cradle Mountain in Tasmania. She lights a mean campfire, struggles with the bullshit in the real world and almost never wears make-up, deodorant or perfume. Joss, we salute you.
Josy: No time to waste here folks. If you go around to her house don’t expect to just sit around and watch the TV, no sir. If you’re lucky you’ll get to go on a hike somewhere, you might get to have a snorkel in the sea, or maybe you’ll get to spin the centrifuge she made which enables her to collect all the honey from her hive. Josy is just bloody splendid. The End.
Jourdan: Mmm, we watched her game last week from up in the commentary box and we're concerned she's not putting in enough effort. You can't sit back and just expect the ball to come to you Jourdan. Sure, some days it happens like that and you've been lucky in the past, but you need to work on your fitness, both physical and mental. You've got the raw talent, we've seen it, what we want is just a little more application. Good luck!
Jourdie: Professional arsonist. So, bloody well STAND BACK!!
Joy: An old fashion version of Ally. She loves drinking a nice whisky with her grandchildren, and we hope that in the modern era she doesn’t become extinct.
Joyce: The Stalwart. She’s past middle age nowadays and more relaxed with herself and the state of the world, but she still possesses a load of spunk. Joyce will tell you what’s wrong with you without the slightest compunction and then give you a kiss on the cheek, afterwards, to remind you that she still loves you. And she does. And that’s what matters.
Jozica: Like Cassandra, Jozica is happiest when she's naked on her horse. Unlike Cassandra, however, Jozica is more into riding naked through forests while groups of young boys try to run after her.
Juanita: Juanita has the personality and demeanour of an old pot being clanged repeatedly by an enthusiastic six year old wielding a metal ladle, and who is helping his or her mother, father or guardian concoct dinner.
Jude: Jude works at the pub where she pulls a mean beer. Laughs a lot. Fights hard.
Judi: Never judge a book by it’s cover ladies and gentlemen: this is what Judi reminds us. She’s the kind of soul, who, as a young adventurer, would happily agree to get paid to swim around underwater topless, in a swimming pool, which actually formed the wall of an expensive Japanese nightclub. And on land she probably talks to the animals, not that you’d ever hear about it. In short, Judi lives well and her rather inspirational life is totally experiential.
Judith: “Oh, Judith!” you cry, after the shit of a pigeon lands in your hair. Soon, though, you remember that it is good luck and you smile.
Judy: Yeah, Judy is great. Just be careful because she carries a concealed weapon most of the time. It’s all good, but just be careful.
Juju: Juju will only attend a show or some kind of staged performance if it is promised that all or any male cast members take all their clothes off at the end of it.
Jules: Jules is cool and all you have to do is look at her close female friends to understand why; Jackie, Stef, Bec, Janie, Nat and Libs. That says it all.
Julia: Like a loud and busy kitchen after someone has just dropped a stack of plates, Julia is as fun to be with as she is all over the shop.
Juliana: The PA who could do a better job than the CEO she works for.
Julianne:
Would she plunge all her money into a hot tip from someone working at the stock market?
No - she's not that impulsive.
Would she make a bee-line for the delicious man she spies across a crowded room?
No - she's not that outgoing.
Would she compose herself at the freshly-happened car crash, take a few deep breaths and begin pointing, bandaging and delegating?
Damn right she would - and she'd save lives in the process.
Julie: Julie is lovely, but once in a while, at least, Julie rhymes with It’s Nice To See You But I’m A Little Flustered, it rhymes with I’m Happy And I’m Sorry I’m Late, and occasionally it rhymes with Life’s Okay But I Think I Married The Wrong Man. Disregarding all of that, remember that Julie is a decent, compassionate person and we up here in the commentary box are grateful she’s on the team list. And if she decides to ditch any useless men then she’s got our blessing. Amen.
Julie-Ann: If Julie-Ann says she wants to help what she's actually saying is that she is taking over. We suggest you either shoot her or hand over the reigns completely. There is simply no middle ground with Julie-Ann. And don't worry, she'll do a good job. (She might also spend the next year telling you about all the problems she faced.)
Juliet: Like Repunzel, Juliet sits in a locked room at the top of the castle awaiting the arrival of her knight in shining armour. Not a Richard, for he cannot see the castle today, more like a knight called Dudley. Dudley the Knight? Are you out there, boy?
Juliette: Rarely jaded, Juliette tends to say yes rather than no. Which means she tries things out, she has a go, she gives it a crack. Why don't more people do this? Occasionally she seems to look a little bothered or pestered, but she's not really. She's just figuring out how to do whatever it is she's about to do.
June: June is from the country. She used to swim in the river as a little girl and, now, as a mature and wise adult, she is a rock for everyone she knows and loves. To be honest, like Carol, she could probably use a few months away.
Junett:
Like a field of sunflowers bursting into bloom in Northern France, at first, Junett is exotic and saucy and refreshing, but picnics in the French country-side, let alone anywhere else, require an organisational captain to oversee preparations.

Are the baguettes fresh?

Did you bring the bottle opener?

Have you dusted off that blanket?

Where is the olive oil - no, not that cheap shit. I want the double cold pressed virgin stuff, thanks.

And what about the basket? Is it going to fall apart?

Don't worry, Junett is all there for the fun and reverie of a delicious afternoon with friends, and she has plenty, but if you're going to do something you might as well do it to the best of your ability, otherwise it'll all end in tears.

I've no idea what her husband/partner/lovers are like, suffice to say they might need to be in excellent physical shape!

Bonjour Junett, ma cherie, et buon chance!
Justice:
No, she's no cop, but she does have a hard head on her and is happy to make the tough decisions. In fact, if anything, her name has led her down the path of subtle leadership. And if she goes off the rails, she goes off the rails at full throttle, which kind of sits with her mantra anyway:

if you're going to do something you might as well do it to the best of your ability.

She'd be good in the armed forces.
Justina: Just like a faulty submarine, Justina attempts to do her best work when she’s hidden but there isn’t much that’s subtle about her, which means secret little ventures always get found out. Be that as it may, criticism washes off her like it’s nothing and she’s an expressive lover.
Justine: The mortar that holds any brick wall together. Often incredibly sexy, try building a civilisation without her and it will probably fall apart. Once she makes her mind up that’s it forever.
Juzzy: Juzzy bought a $3000 karaoke machine and unlike J9 below, she knows how to use it. Juzzy calls it how it is and by god can she look after herself.
